model.name: EVOKE Turbo World 14B
model.description: EVOKE makes an explorable world from a start image: the camera walks and turns through it 1.5 seconds at a time while the world keeps a depth memory of what it has shown, so places you return to keep their layout. Explore it with the keyboard in the Worlds gallery; 640x384, slower per second of video than Hy-Nomas, and its depth model is for non-commercial use.
